focus_areas: Edge definition between white fur and brown carpet
Anatomical correctness of the visible eye and ear
Consistency of fur texture (silky vs. AI-smoothed)
Verification of Blenheim specific coloring patterns
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Focus heavily on the boundary between the dog's white fur and the brown carpet. AI generators often struggle with high-contrast edges on textured backgrounds, leading to 'haloing' or texture smearing. Also, verify if the visible eye has a natural reflection and depth, or if it appears flat/painted. Specifically inspect the left edge of the image where the muzzle is cropped for signs of anatomical melting or structural collapse.
image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a Blenheim spaniel lying on a brown textured carpet. The dog is positioned horizontally, with its head on the left and body extending to the right. The coat features distinct chestnut red patches on a white background. The long, feathered ears are prominent. The muzzle area is partially cropped at the left edge, and the rear/tail is out of frame.
